text: Anda mengajak kawan di depan anda makan bersama: “Jom, … pergi makan!” Kata ganti mana yang tepat?
gloss: Inviting the friend in front of you to eat together: "Come on, … go eat!" Which pronoun fits? — kita: Malay splits "we" into inclusive kita (listener included) and exclusive kami (listener excluded).

text: Penjodoh bilangan “sehelai” dipakai untuk benda yang nipis. Yang manakah dikira dengan “sehelai”?
gloss: The classifier "sehelai" is used for thin things. Which is counted with it? — A shirt (sehelai kemeja). Shoes are sepasang, a cup sebiji, an umbrella sekaki.

text: “Saya tertinggal dompet di rumah.” Awalan ter- di sini menunjukkan perbuatan itu dilakukan…
gloss: "I left (tertinggal) my wallet at home." The prefix ter- here shows the act was done... — unintentionally: ter- marks an accidental action.

text: Berapakah deria yang dirangkumkan dalam perkataan “pancaindera”?
gloss: How many senses does the word "pancaindera" cover? — Five: panca is the Sanskrit-derived word for five.

text: Mod “Jangan Ganggu” pada telefon pintar menyenyapkan apa?
gloss: What does a smartphone's "Do Not Disturb" mode silence? — Calls and notifications; the internet, GPS and camera keep working.

text: Selepas mandi air panas, cermin bilik air menjadi kabur. Mengapa?
gloss: After a hot shower the bathroom mirror fogs up. Why? — Water vapour condenses on the cooler mirror into tiny droplets.

text: Mengapa badan kita menggigil apabila kesejukan?
gloss: Why do we shiver when cold? — Rapid muscle contractions generate heat.

text: Dalam WhatsApp, apabila dua tanda rait bertukar biru, mesej anda sudah…
gloss: In WhatsApp, when the two ticks turn blue, your message has been... — read. Grey ticks mean delivered.

text: Ular kerap menjelirkan lidahnya yang bercabang. Untuk apa?
gloss: Snakes often flick their forked tongue. Why? — To smell: the tongue picks up scent particles and carries them to the Jacobson's organ in the mouth.

text: Dalam filem animasi “Frozen”, puteri manakah yang boleh menghasilkan ais dan salji?
gloss: In the animated film "Frozen", which princess can make ice and snow? — Elsa. Anna is her sister.

text: Platform media sosial Twitter ditukar nama pada tahun 2023 kepada apa?
gloss: Twitter was renamed in 2023 to what? — X. Threads is Meta's rival app; Bluesky another rival.

text: Dalam panggilan video, apakah kesan menekan butang mikrofon bergaris (mute)?
options: Orang lain tidak dapat mendengar anda
Anda tidak dapat mendengar orang lain
gloss: In a video call, what does pressing the crossed-out microphone (mute) do? — Others can no longer hear you.

text: Mengapa tayar kereta mempunyai bunga (alur) yang dalam?
gloss: Why do car tyres have deep treads? — To channel water away so the tyre keeps its grip and does not aquaplane.

text: Dalam catur, buah manakah hanya boleh bergerak secara serong?
gloss: In chess, which piece can move only diagonally? — The bishop (gajah in Malay). The queen (menteri) also moves straight; the rook (tir) only straight.

text: Dalam bola keranjang, jaringan dari luar garisan lengkung besar bernilai berapa mata?
gloss: In basketball, a basket from beyond the big arc is worth how many points? — 3.

text: Bandar Dubai terletak di negara mana?
gloss: Dubai is in which country? — The United Arab Emirates.

text: Dengan DuitNow, anda boleh memindahkan wang hanya dengan mengetahui apa tentang penerima?
gloss: With DuitNow, you can transfer money knowing only what about the recipient? — Their mobile number (a MyKad or business number also works as a DuitNow ID).

text: Rumpai laut kering yang membalut sushi gulung dipanggil apa?
gloss: The dried seaweed wrapping sushi rolls is called? — Nori. Wakame and kombu are other seaweeds; agar-agar a jelly made from seaweed.

text: Nombor SPF pada losyen pelindung matahari menunjukkan perlindungan daripada apa?
gloss: The SPF number on sunscreen shows protection from what? — Ultraviolet (UVB) rays: Sun Protection Factor.

text: Bateri telefon tinggal 20% dan susut 1% setiap 3 minit. Berapa lama lagi sebelum habis?
gloss: The phone battery is at 20% and drops 1% every 3 minutes. How long until empty? — 1 hour: 20 × 3 = 60 minutes.

text: Dalam sepak takraw, pemain tidak boleh menyentuh bola dengan bahagian badan apa?
gloss: In sepak takraw, which body part may players not touch the ball with? — Hands; head, knees, chest and feet are allowed.

text: Negeri manakah digelar “Negeri di Bawah Bayu”?
gloss: Which state is called "the Land below the Wind"? — Sabah, south of the typhoon belt.

text: Nama “orang utan” yang dipakai di seluruh dunia berasal daripada bahasa apa?
gloss: The name "orangutan", used worldwide, comes from which language? — Malay: orang (person) + hutan (forest).

text: Kompang yang mengiringi perarakan pengantin dimainkan dengan cara apa?
gloss: How is the kompang that accompanies a wedding procession played? — Struck with the palm: it is a frame drum.

text: Dalam cerita rakyat, Sang Kancil menyeberangi sungai dengan melompat di atas belakang haiwan apa?
gloss: In the folk tale, Sang Kancil crosses a river by hopping on the backs of which animals? — Crocodiles, pretending to count them for the king.

text: Dalam pantun empat kerat, dua baris pertama dipanggil apa?
gloss: In a four-line pantun, what are the first two lines called? — Pembayang (the foreshadowing); the last two are the maksud (meaning).

text: Hari Raya Aidiladha disambut dengan ibadah apa?
gloss: Eid al-Adha is marked by which act of worship? — Korban, the sacrifice of livestock. Fasting, zakat fitrah and tarawih belong to Ramadan.

text: Di kedai kopi, “kopi O” bermaksud kopi tanpa apa?
gloss: At a coffee shop, "kopi O" means coffee without what? — Milk. Without sugar is "kopi O kosong".

text: Makam Mahsuri, tokoh legenda “sumpahan tujuh keturunan”, terletak di pulau mana?
gloss: Mahsuri's tomb, the legendary figure of the "seven-generation curse", is on which island? — Langkawi.

text: Dalam bahasa Melayu lama, “mata-mata” merujuk kepada siapa?
gloss: In older Malay, who is a "mata-mata"? — A policeman (hence "balai mata-mata" for a police station).

text: Nombor MyKad 850214-08-xxxx. Bilakah pemiliknya lahir?
gloss: An IC number begins 850214-08. When was the holder born? — 14 February 1985: the first six digits are YYMMDD; 08 is the place-of-birth code.

text: Sebelum dikenali sebagai Singapura, pulau itu disebut dalam catatan lama dengan nama apa?
gloss: Before it was called Singapura, the island appears in old records under which name? — Temasek. The others are early kingdoms on the peninsula.

text: Wau bulan, layang-layang yang diabadikan dalam logo MAS, sinonim dengan negeri mana?
gloss: The wau bulan, the kite in the Malaysia Airlines logo, is synonymous with which state? — Kelantan.

text: Mengikut tatabahasa baku, frasa manakah yang betul?
gloss: By standard grammar, which phrase is correct? — "para guru": a plural word (para, semua, banyak) is not followed by a reduplicated noun, which would mark plural twice.

text: E-mel dihantar kepada Ali, Siti dalam CC dan Ahmad dalam BCC. Siapa tidak tahu Ahmad turut menerimanya?
gloss: An e-mail goes to Ali, with Siti in CC and Ahmad in BCC. Who does not know Ahmad received it? — Ali and Siti: BCC recipients are hidden from all other recipients.

text: Antibiotik berkesan melawan jangkitan yang disebabkan oleh apa?
gloss: Antibiotics work against infections caused by what? — Bacteria; they do nothing against viruses such as the common cold.

text: Dalam tenis, markah sifar disebut dengan perkataan apa?
gloss: In tennis, what word means a score of zero? — Love. Deuce is 40–40; an ace is an unreturned serve.

text: Kumpulan darah manakah digelar “penderma universal” bagi sel darah merah?
gloss: Which blood type is the "universal donor" for red cells? — O negative. AB positive is the universal recipient.

text: Bagaimanakah ketuhar gelombang mikro memanaskan makanan?
gloss: How does a microwave oven heat food? — By making the water molecules in the food vibrate (rotate), which produces heat inside it.

text: Siri “Squid Game” yang popular di Netflix berasal dari negara mana?
gloss: The Netflix hit "Squid Game" comes from which country? — South Korea.

text: Dalam bola sepak, pemain tidak boleh dikira ofsaid jika menerima bola terus daripada apa?
gloss: In football, a player cannot be offside when receiving the ball directly from what? — A throw-in (also a goal kick or corner kick, not among the options); a free kick and any pass or header from a teammate can still lead to offside.

text: Pencuci mulut Itali “affogato” ialah espresso panas yang dituang ke atas apa?
gloss: The Italian dessert "affogato" is hot espresso poured over what? — Ice cream (usually vanilla gelato); affogato means "drowned".

text: Isnin bermaksud “dua” dan Khamis “lima” dalam bahasa Arab. Ahad pula bermaksud?
gloss: Isnin means "two" and Khamis "five" in Arabic. What does Ahad mean? — One: Malay weekday names count from Ahad (1) to Khamis (5), from Arabic ahad, ithnayn, thalatha, arba'a, khamsa.

text: Kelip-kelip di Kampung Kuantan, Kuala Selangor, berkumpul pada waktu malam di pokok apa?
gloss: The fireflies of Kampung Kuantan, Kuala Selangor, gather at night on which tree? — The berembang (Sonneratia caseolaris) along the riverbank.

text: Novel “Salina” (1961) ialah karya Sasterawan Negara yang mana?
gloss: The novel "Salina" (1961) is by which National Laureate? — A. Samad Said. All four are National Laureates.

text: Dalam air, tin kola biasa tenggelam tetapi tin kola diet terapung. Apakah puncanya?
gloss: In water, a can of regular cola sinks but diet cola floats. Why? — Sugar: about 35 g of dissolved sugar makes the regular can denser than water; sweetener is used in tiny amounts.

text: Negara ASEAN manakah tidak mempunyai pantai?
gloss: Which ASEAN country has no coastline? — Laos, the only landlocked member.

text: Gelaran “Bendahara”, pembesar tertinggi Kesultanan Melaka, berasal daripada bahasa apa?
gloss: The title "Bendahara", the highest official of the Malacca Sultanate, comes from which language? — Sanskrit (bhāṇḍāgāra, storehouse/treasury).

text: Tim Berners-Lee mencipta World Wide Web ketika bekerja di institusi mana?
gloss: Tim Berners-Lee invented the World Wide Web while working where? — CERN, near Geneva, in 1989.

text: Batu bersurat Kedukan Bukit, bukti awal bahasa Melayu Kuno dari abad ke-7, dikaitkan dengan kerajaan apa?
gloss: The Kedukan Bukit inscription, early evidence of Old Malay from the 7th century, is linked to which kingdom? — Srivijaya (dated 683 CE, near Palembang).
